errors.evidence: This describes the approximate range of the data values, not the range of the y-axis itself. The visible tick marks on the y-axis range from 0.4 to 0.8.
The data point for vanilla SFT at x=4 is at an accuracy of approximately 0.40, not 0.42.
The line for vanilla SFT increases from x=4 to x=5, it does not remain constant. The value at x=5 is approximately 0.41, not 0.42.
